chapter.verse: “Mite' muh dingin amau' mai-ah na diktatna uh na lah loh ding uh kidawm un; a hang pen vantunga om na Pa uh' kiangpan pahtakman na ngah kei ding uh hi.

“Tua hi a, a kitangsam mite na piak uh ciangin a puatham kineihte in midangte' phat ding utna tawh vengkhawm innte leh lampi tunga ahih ngei danun na mai uhah pengkul tumsak kei un. Maantak kong cihin ah amau' ngah ding pahtakman a ngah khin uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin note in a kitangsam mite na piak uh ciangin na taklam khut ii sepna na veilam khut uh theisak kei un.
Tua hileh na piakkhiatna uh kilang lo ding a, a kilanglo mun pan hong en na Pa un pahtakman hong pia ding hi.

“Thu na nget uh ciangin zong a puatham kineihte bang hikei un. A hang pen tua mite in midangte' muh ding utna tawh vengkhawm innte leh lamkabomte ah dingto-a thunget pakta uh hi. Maantak kong cihin ah amau' ngah ding pahtakman a ngah khin uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin note in thu na nget uh ciangin na inndei sungtawng uhah lutin kongpi na khak ding uh a, a kilanglo mun-a om na Pa uh' kiangah thu na ngen ding uh hi.
“Thu na nget uh ciangin zong Gentile mite' hih bangin kam tampi zang kei un; a hang pen tua mite in kam tampi zatna tawh a thunget uh a kiza deuh ding sa uh hi.
Tua mite bang hikei un; a hang pen thu na nget ma-un na Pa un na kisapte uh thei hi.
Tua hi a, hih bangin thu na ngen un: “Vantunga om kote' Pa aw, na min siangtho kizahtak hen.
Na kumpigam hong tung henla, vantung bangin leitung ah zong nangma' deihna kisem ta hen.
Tuni' ading kote' khamkhop an hong pia in.
A hong khialte maisak khinzo ka hih bangun ko' khialhna zong hong maisak in.
Siatzolna sung hong tunpih ke'n. Gilo' kiangpan hong honkhia in. (A hang pen kumpigam, vangliatna leh minphatna, nangma' a hi tawntung hi. Amen.)
“A hang pen midangte' tatkhialhna na maisak uhleh na vantung Pa un zong note hong maisak ding hi.
Ahih hangin midangte' tatkhialhna na maisak kei uhleh na Pa un zong note' tatkhialhna hong maisak lo ding hi.

“Antan na neih uh ciangin zong a puatham kineihte bangin vulsuah kei un; a hang pen tua mite in antang ahihlam uh midangte' muh nadingin a maisuah siasak uh hi. Maantak kong cihin ah amau' ngah ding pahtakman a ngah khin uh ahi hi.
Ahih hangin antan na neih uh ciangin na lu uh sathau nilh unla, na mai uh phiatsiang un.
Tua hileh na antan lam uh midangte in hong mu lo-in a kilanglo mun-a om na Pa un hong mu ding a, a kilanglo mun pan hong en na Pa un pahtakman hong pia ding hi.
“Nget leh kekseu in a siatsak theihna mun, gutate in buluhin a guk theihna mun ahi leitung ah sumlepai na khol kei un.
Nget leh kekseu in a siatsak theihlohna, gutate in buluhin a guk theihlohna mun vantung ah sumlepai na khol un.
A hang pen na sumkholna mun ah na lungsim zong om ding hi.
“Mit pen pumpi ii meivak ahi hi. Tua hi a, na mit a cidam leh na pumpi bup taang ding a,
na mit a siat leh na pumpi bup mial ding hi. Na sunga om khuavak pen khuamial ahih mawk leh bangzahin mial ding hiam!

“To nih a don zo kuamah om lo hi; a hang pen khat hua-in a dang khat it, ahihkeileh khat pibawlin a dang khat neubawl, khatzawzaw hiding hi. Note in Pasian' na leh sum' na na semkhawm theikei ding uh hi.

“Tua hi a, note kong cihin ah bang ne ding bang dawn ding ci-in na nuntakna uh' ading ahi zongin, bang silh ding ci-in na pumpi uh' ading ahi zongin lunghimawh kei un. Nuntakna pen anletui vai sangin leh pumpi pen silhleten vai sangin thupizaw hilo ahi hiam?
Huihlak vasate en dih un; amaute in khaici lah tuh lo, an lah la lo, ansal ah lah khol lo napi uh na vantung Pa un amaute vak veve hi. Tua vasate sangin note manphazaw hilo na hi uh hiam?
Tua banah note lakah lunghihmawh manin ama' nuntak sautan tong khat beek a khangkhan thei kua om na hi uh hiam?
Tua hi a, bang hangin silhleten vai lunghimawh na hi uh hiam? Gamlak-a unok kungte bangci khan cih lungngai dih un. Tuate in naham zong sem lo, khau zong khek lo uh hi.
Hinapi ke'n kong cihin ah Solomon nangawn a thupitna teng tawh a kithawi laitak hihte khat zahin etlawm lo lai hi.
No, upna neu mite aw, tuni hingin zingciang meikhuk sunga kilawnsuk gamlak lopate Pasian in puansilh guan ahihleh note hong guanzaw kan ding hilo hiam?
Tua ahih manin, ‘Bang ka ne ding hiam?’ ahihkeileh ‘Bang ka dawn ding hiam?’ ci-in lunghimawh kei un.
A hang pen Gentile mite in hihte khempeuh zonpi-in nei uh a, na vantung Pa un zong tuate a vekin na kisap lam uh thei hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian' kumpigam leh ama' dikna zong masa un; tua hileh tua nate khempeuh zong hong kipiathuah ding hi.
“Tua ahih manin zingciang vai ding lunghimawh kei un; a hang pen zingciang vai ding zingciang mah na lunghimawh lel ding hi. Nisima om lungkhamna tua ni' ading kicingkhop hi.
